messages.author: Michael Goldstein
messages.body:
Hello,
I am trying to install AmberTools21 on a red hat linux cluster. Should I
follow the fedora install instructions, or is there something else I should
do?
Thanks for your help,
Michael
PhD student
Chemistry Department
Boston College

messages.author: Jason Swails
